newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber flat in slow late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber flat in slow late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were flat in slow late trading on Wednesday with no deals heard, dealers said.
Dealers said January SIR20 offer prices remained at 55.50-56.00 cents fob Medan, 55.25-55.75 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang, 54.50-55.00 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
January SIR20 was last bought at 55.25 fob Medan and at 54.75 fob Palembang by U.S. firms late on Tuesday, they said.
One Bandung-based dealer said prompt delivery latex was on offer at 2,150 rupiah/kg against the previous 2,200 rupiah due to weak demand. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
